subject: EdgeCloud connector: evidence package + co-sell listing next steps
messages:
From: Alice Huang <alice@edgecloud.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: EdgeCloud connector: evidence package + co-sell listing next steps

Hi Monica (and team),

Thanks again for the run-through last week — EdgeCloud is excited to move our connector into the Redwood marketplace and pursue co-sell with ACME Health. Per our checklist call, I attached an evidence binder with the artifacts you requested and a first-pass SOW we can iterate on.

Quick summary:
- Target listings: AWS Marketplace (Seller Private Offer) + GCP Marketplace (Partner listing).
- Primary asks from your side: security matrix, integration diagrams, SaaS metering approach, and a publisher checklist for GCP.
- Target launch window: late Q1 2027 (flexible).

Attachments: edgecloud-evidence-binder.pdf, acme-sow-draft.docx, gcp-publisher-checklist.xlsx
Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bEdgeCloudEvidence

Could you confirm the following so we can schedule an internal handoff?
1) Which Redwood lead should own the meter/entitlement questions for billing integration?
2) Any mandatory format for the security artifacts (SOC2 system description vs. one-page summary)?
3) Is there a preferred template for the co-sell one-pager we should fill out for your GTM team?

Looping Samir (ACME) so they can confirm any procurement constraints on their side.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min sync early next week.

Best,
Alice Huang
Head of Partnerships, EdgeCloud Analytics
alice@edgecloud.io

---
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Huang <alice@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeCloud connector: evidence package + co-sell listing next steps

Hi Alice — thanks for sending the binder and the SOW. I skimmed the drive link and the attachments look good at a high level.

Answers up-front:
- Meter/entitlement ownership: Karthik will lead meter integration and confirm if we need a billing shim or can use native usage reports.
- Security artifacts: we accept a SOC2 system description + a redacted control mapping spreadsheet; if you only have a one-pager we can accept that for initial review but will need the control mapping before publisher approval.
- Co-sell one-pager: we have a short template — I can share it (internal link below) and drop in the core GTM asks.

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal technical triage (Karthik) to validate metering approach and gap list — target by 11/12.
2) Legal/procurement starter checklist (Marissa) to confirm any reserved terms for Marketplace private offers.
3) Joint handoff call with ACME and EdgeCloud the week of 11/15 to align SOW and marketplace listing requirements.

Are you available 11/16 or 11/17 for a 30-min call? If so I will send a calendar invite and include our GTM lead.

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

On Sun, Nov 8, 2026 at 3:12 PM Alice Huang <alice@edgecloud.io> wrote:
> Hi Monica (and team),
> 
> Thanks again for the run-through last week — EdgeCloud is excited to move our connector into the Redwood marketplace and pursue co-sell with ACME Health....
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeCloud connector: evidence package + co-sell listing next steps

Monica / Marissa — I pulled the binder this morning. Quick tech triage notes and asks so we can scope the work before the joint call:

Technical evidence needed (minimum):
- Integration diagram showing where customer data flows and where tokens/keys are stored (redact any PII).
- Metering approach: do you emit per-customer token counts or per-API-call aggregates? We prefer sample output of the usage report (CSV) or a reporting API endpoint spec.
- KV/cache and session retention policy — how long are contexts held for billed usage?
- A short performance note: expected avg RPS and typical seq length for demo tenant.

Operational asks:
- Will EdgeCloud require a dedicated Redwood Dedicated pool for ACME (SLA) or are they planning to use hosted with reserved capacity? This affects our entitlement options.
- If they want a private offer on AWS, we need an explicit billing contact and partner acceptance flow.

I can own the metering validation and produce a one-page gap list by EOD 11/12. Marissa, can you confirm legal review timeline (contract redlines / PO requirements)?

-Karthik
Engineering Lead, Integrations

From: Alice Huang <alice@edgecloud.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeCloud connector: evidence package + co-sell listing next steps

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear ask list. I uploaded the integration diagram and a sample usage-export CSV to the shared drive (see links below). Also attached an updated SOW that clarifies billing contact and deployment preference (hosted with reserved capacity for ACME).

Attachments: edgecloud-evidence-binder.pdf (updated), acme-sow-draft.docx (v2)
Drive links:
- Integration diagram: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1diagEdgeCloud
- Usage CSV sample: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1usageEdgeCloudSample

Notes:
- Metering: we currently emit per-customer aggregate CSVs hourly; we can add an API endpoint if preferred (engineering estimate 2 sprints).
- Data retention: session contexts are retained for 7 days by default and fully purged after 30 days; this is configurable per-customer.
- SLA: for ACME we plan to reserve capacity and can commit to a 99.9% uptime SLO under the reserved plan.

Happy to discuss on the 11/16 or 11/17 slot. Samir — can you confirm 11/17 at 10am PT?

Best,
Alice
Head of Partnerships, EdgeCloud Analytics

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Huang <alice@edgecloud.io>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeCloud connector: evidence package + co-sell listing next steps

All — great progress. Confirming next steps and owners:

- Karthik: produce metering validation + one-page gap list by 11/12 (owner for billing integration).
- Marissa: start legal intake for private offer terms and review SOW v2; confirm earliest contract milestones by 11/18.
- Alice / EdgeCloud: will share the integration diagram and usage CSV (received) and confirm any redactions needed.
- Monica (me): I will share the co-sell one-pager template and create the HubSpot deal record (EDGE-2026-071). Meeting scheduled: 11/17 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Related links: HubSpot deal — https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/EDGE-2026-071; Drive folder — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bEdgeCloudEvidence

Please reply if any of the owners need to swap dates. Otherwise I'll track in the partner tracker and update the listing queue after legal sign-off.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this listed.

Monica
Director, Partnerships (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
